g.text: Simulated design only: nothing built in hardware.

g.desc: Simulated design only: nothing built in hardware.

g.text: Six-step (trapezoidal) drive: in each 60 deg sector one high side switches at 20 kHz with its low side as

g.desc: Six-step (trapezoidal) drive: in each 60 deg sector one high side switches at 20 kHz with its low side as

g.text: synchronous rectifier, one low side is on, one leg floats. Dead time (500 ns) is inserted by the firmware

g.desc: synchronous rectifier, one low side is on, one leg floats. Dead time (500 ns) is inserted by the firmware

g.text: (compare pair per leg, src/bldc/bldc.c); the IR2101 has no internal interlock, so the MCU timing is the

g.desc: (compare pair per leg, src/bldc/bldc.c); the IR2101 has no internal interlock, so the MCU timing is the

g.text: only protection against shoot-through (sim/ngspice/leg_deadtime.cir: shoot-through below about 250 ns).

g.desc: only protection against shoot-through (sim/ngspice/leg_deadtime.cir: shoot-through below about 250 ns).

g.text: Gate pull-downs (R13/R14...) hold the bridge off while the MCU is in reset; R71-R76 hold the driver inputs low.

g.desc: Gate pull-downs (R13/R14...) hold the bridge off while the MCU is in reset; R71-R76 hold the driver inputs low.

g.text: RS1 2.5 mOhm + U4 INA181A1 (gain 20): ISENSE = 1.65 V + 50 mV/A, sampled at the PWM counter peak.

g.desc: RS1 2.5 mOhm + U4 INA181A1 (gain 20): ISENSE = 1.65 V + 50 mV/A, sampled at the PWM counter peak.

g.text: VBUS_SNS = VBUS / 11. Hall sensors: open collector, 12 V supply, 4.7k pull-ups to 3.3 V, 1k / 1 nF filter.

g.desc: VBUS_SNS = VBUS / 11. Hall sensors: open collector, 12 V supply, 4.7k pull-ups to 3.3 V, 1k / 1 nF filter.

g.text: J5 goes to the MCU: PWM_xH / PWM_xL from a centre-aligned timer, HALL_A-C to GPIO, ISENSE / VBUS_SNS to ADC.

g.desc: J5 goes to the MCU: PWM_xH / PWM_xL from a centre-aligned timer, HALL_A-C to GPIO, ISENSE / VBUS_SNS to ADC.
